original_test_intent: Read DCMI platform power telemetry through the local in-band BMC path and validate the returned power statistics and measurement context without changing any power policy.
original_method: Retain the exact local raw 0x2c 0x02 0xdc 0x01 0 0 request, decode its documented fields and compare them with the target telemetry contract under a recorded load and time context.
manual_activity: The project supplies the DCMI response layout, expected power-statistics semantics and platform/load acceptance context; the end user owns PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED.
required_inputs: Platform operating/load context and applicable range policy
safety_requirements: No reset, shutdown or workload control
agent_execution_scope: Bind local interface to intended SUT
Issue the exact bounded raw request
engineer_actions: Provide schema, measurement semantics and expected context
Review telemetry anomalies or unsupported fields

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The high-level `dcmi power reading` output is supplemental, while SSH is unnecessary for a named local execution unless the runner topology is separately approved; neither proves the exact source raw request or field framing.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: On the verified local interface, issue `ipmitool raw 0x2c 0x02 0xdc 0x01 0 0` once with a bounded timeout, preserve the bytes and decode all documented power, timestamp and statistics-window fields.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The source opcode/payload and 10/5 timing remain; no watt range or sampling interval is invented.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Capture one source-exact raw DCMI power response with contemporaneous workload and time context, validate every documented field and clearly distinguish instantaneous, average, minimum and maximum values and their measurement interval.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds decoding, field-role, freshness and contextual acceptance gates beyond command completion.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: The high-level wrapper can aid readability but cannot replace raw payload coverage; the OOB sibling does not prove the local transport.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A plausible watt value may be stale, mis-scaled or associated with a different statistics window; a single sample does not characterize continuous power behavior.

project_override_considerations: A Redfish/vendor telemetry API is equivalent only if field roles, units, measurement window, freshness and local-route coverage are mapped; omitted raw protocol behavior must be disclosed.
expected_evidence: Approved DCMI response contract and decoder version
Exact request and complete raw response with completion/length
Decoded field roles, watts scaling and statistics
Timestamp or measurement interval and freshness result
No power, thermal, reset, workload, configuration or log mutation

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The title and raw procedure consistently specify an in-band DCMI power read. The success-only criterion is incomplete rather than contradictory; the DeepSeek wrapper is an overlay fidelity gap.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The operation and raw payload are explicit. Response schema, measurement semantics and load context are normal project readiness inputs.

review_improvement: Converts an opaque command-success check into a time- and load-attributed validation of DCMI power fields and statistics.
independent_technical_reasoning: DCMI power data can carry several watt values over a defined sampling interval rather than one universal reading. A decoder must preserve which value is current, average, minimum or maximum, apply the correct byte order and units, and prove the measurement window is fresh relative to the captured workload. Otherwise a syntactically successful reply can support a numerically plausible but false engineering conclusion.
